profiles.Baby Rollen: Baby Rollén is a London-based DJ and producer who founded and runs Slump Recordings. He plays house, breakbeat and acid-leaning club music. He appears on London radio (Rinse FM, Balamii, Bloop London, Keep Hush) and at UK festivals and clubs such as Gottwood. He has remixed Eris Drew and Kariya and works with collaborators including Desert Sound Colony and Anna Kohlin.
profiles.Appleblim: Appleblim (Laurie Osborne) is a Bristol-born, Berlin-based DJ and producer who emerged in the UK dubstep scene and co-founded the Skull Disco label with Shackleton. His sets move from early dubstep and grime to techno, bass and tech-house hybrids. He plays and broadcasts on Rinse FM, Sub FM, HÖR Berlin, Boiler Room and Resident Advisor, and he plays clubs such as Berghain, fabric and Ministry of Sound. He runs the Aus Music-affiliated Apple Pips label and often works as a duo with Second Storey, as Also.
profiles.D'Julz: D'Julz is a Paris-based French house and techno DJ and producer who got his start on Radio FG in the early 2000s. He founded the Bass Culture Records label and its Rex Club party series in Paris, and hosts the long-running Home Diggin' show on Rinse France. His sets run through deep house, disco, tech house and techno. He plays Rex Club in Paris, fabric in London, Circoloco at DC10 in Ibiza, Cocoon Ibiza, Watergate in Berlin and Barcelona, Womb in Tokyo, Sonus Festival in Croatia, Boiler Room Paris, HÖR Berlin and Refuge in New York.
profiles.Ben UFO: Ben UFO (Benjamin Thomson) is a London-based British DJ and co-founder of the Hessle Audio label, working in UK bass, house, techno, club and dubstep-rooted electronic music. He has a long-running Hessle Audio radio show on Rinse FM, earlier Sub FM shows (Ruffage Sessions, Bruk Radio), the BBC Essential Mix (2013, 2021) and a BBC Radio 1 residency. He plays internationally at Boiler Room, Dekmantel, fabric, XOYO, The Lot Radio and Kiosk Radio, and he often plays with Joy Orbison, Pearson Sound, Pangaea and Four Tet.
profiles.Adam Pits: Adam Pits is a London-based DJ and Rinse FM regular with a monthly show through 2023–24. Their sets are eclectic, moving between house, breaks, trance, ambient and techno. They co-run the Space Cadets series with Lisene, which has a Limbo Radio show and Hypersoft nights. They play club and festival sets at fabric, Dimensions, Nowadays (New York), NUDE (Berlin) and KAUZ (Zurich), and have toured to Bengaluru and Hyderabad.
profiles.Boogie Blind: DJ Boogie Blind is a New York City hip hop turntablist and vinyl DJ, a member of the X-Ecutioners (formerly the X-Men) and a DJ battle champion who has appeared at DMC. He plays boom-bap, golden-era and Diggin' in the Crates (DITC) hip hop, Dilla tributes and 45 rpm funk and soul sets. He plays New York radio, Boiler Room NYC, Turntable Lab and Big Crown Records events, and has toured Japan and Europe.
profiles.DJ Pipe: DJ Pipe is a house and underground club DJ from North-West England, now based in Berlin, who performs as dj pipe / global north. He plays downtempo, house and experimental sets, with live recordings from Hoppetosse in Berlin and The Lion & Lamb in London. His radio and festival mixes include The Lot Radio (New York), Room 303 Radio, The Ghost's Ghostcast, Operator's Submid show, and Dimensions Festival's DIM series, including a themuddshow x Dimensions session with Taslo.
profiles.Daniel Bell: Daniel Bell is a Detroit-born techno DJ and producer, based for years in New York and Berlin-linked circuits, who records as DBX and co-founded the Accelerate label. He is known for minimal, dub-inflected Detroit techno, and plays clubs and festivals in the US (Detroit, Movement, Nashville, NYC), Germany (Tresor Berlin, WMF, Distillery Leipzig), plus Europe, Mexico and Scandinavia. His recordings span 1998 to 2026 across radio shows, podcasts and club sets.
profiles.Black Loops: Black Loops (Paffetti) is an Italian house DJ and producer, long associated with Berlin, who plays deep, jazzy, soulful and Italo-influenced house. He releases on Toy Tonics (Gruuv), Pets Recordings and Freerange, and has a long-running monthly Balamii radio residency. He plays regularly at Berlin clubs such as Watergate, Sisyphos, Else and IPSE, and tours internationally, including Paris (Djoon), Vancouver (Soul Hop), New York, San Diego, Tokyo, Toronto, Glasgow, Montreal and Bass Coast.
profiles.Chez Damier: Chez Damier (Anthony Pearson) is a Chicago-born, Detroit- and Berlin-linked house DJ and producer known for deep, soulful house rooted in Chicago and Detroit. He co-founded the Prescription label, ran Balance with Ron Trent, and released on Kevin Saunderson's KMS. He plays clubs, festivals and radio shows in Berlin, London, Paris, Zurich, Palma, New York and the US, and the recordings span 1993 radio and club tapes through 2025 sets.
profiles.Guy Contact: Guy Contact is a Melbourne-born DJ and producer, later based in Berlin, who plays house, deep house, breaks and leftfield club music. He is tied to Melbourne's Butter Sessions label and parties, and his sets run through Melbourne Deepcast and Berlin's Haŵs, HÖR and Refuge Worldwide. He also plays Boiler Room, Essential Mix, Dimensions, Pitch Music & Arts and Sónar, and has mixes on Skylab Radio, Rinse France and Seoul Community Radio.
profiles.Desert Sound Colony: Desert Sound Colony is a London-based DJ, producer and label head who plays house, deep house, techno and breaks-leaning club music. They run Holding Hands Records, whose podcast series features them alongside Bradley Zero, Nathan Micay, Martyn, Breaka and Baby Rollén. They have played London radio and venues (Rinse FM, NTS, Balamii, Bloop London, Eastern Bloc, Junction 2, Dimensions) and also Melbourne Deepcast, Le Protocole Radio, Deep House Amsterdam and Bicep's FMB mixtape series.
profiles.Diamond D: Diamond D (Joseph Kirkland) is a Bronx, New York hip hop producer, rapper and DJ, and a member of the D.I.T.C. (Diggin' in the Crates) crew. He is known for the 1992 album Stunts, Blunts & Hip Hop and for his 1990s boom-bap production. He now plays 'all 45' DJ sets of 7-inch vinyl, often alongside Large Professor, Dan Greenpeace and Mark the 45 King. Those sets have taken him to San Diego, San Francisco, Manchester, the UK (Plan B) and Dubai (Honeycomb, Sole DXB), and to festivals such as A3C and Hip Hop Kemp.
profiles.Frank and Tony: Frank & Tony is a Brooklyn-based deep house duo of Francis Harris and Anthony Collins, who co-run the Scissor & Thread label. They formed in 2012, released the album You Go Girl in 2014, and returned in 2022 with Dream Vibration and the 2024 album Ethos. They play club and festival sets and have done radio and podcast mixes for Resident Advisor, FACT, fabric, NTS, XLR8R and Groove. Their sets include Miami (Treehouse), Dallas (Crème de la Crème), NYC and Oakland (Robot Heart).
profiles.Gene on Earth: Gene On Earth is a Berlin-based, San Francisco Bay Area-born house DJ, producer and label head who runs Limousine Dream. He plays slick, laid-back deep and reduced house, often with vinyl and crate-digging selections. He plays radio and club sets across Europe and the Americas: Dimensions, Dekmantel's Lentekabinet, Love International, Wonderfruit, Boiler Room, The Lot Radio (Brooklyn), RA, NTS, Club Space Miami and Montreal. He often plays back-to-back with Dyed Soundorom.
profiles.Fort Romeau: Fort Romeau is Michael Greene, a British house and techno producer and DJ from London. He plays deep, melodic, slow-burning house with ambient leanings. He is a regular on Boiler Room, Resident Advisor, Mixmag Lab, HÖR, Dekmantel and BBC Radio 1, where he did an Essential Mix in July 2018. His sets span London, Berlin, Amsterdam, Lisbon and New York, plus festivals such as DGTL, Lost Village, Primavera Sound and BBK Live.
profiles.Floating Points: Floating Points is the stage name of Sam Shepherd, an English electronic producer, DJ, and neuroscientist-trained musician based in London. He plays house, disco, broken beat, jazz, ambient and club music. He has long-running ties to NTS Radio, with monthly shows and many sets with Four Tet, Caribou and Jamie xx. He's also linked to Rinse FM, Plastic People and Brilliant Corners in London, the Dimensions festival and Glastonbury's Sunflower Sound System. He has also played in Tokyo, Barcelona, New York and Lyon.
profiles.Korsakow: Korsakow is a 1990s alias of Berlin-based German producer and DJ Alexander (Alex) Krüger, who works in deep house and techno. The same artist records as Dub Taylor (dub techno with a Basic Channel influence, debut album on Raum-Musik in 2001) and as Tigerskin. His Korsakow mix #169 for the Recorder.13 podcast (2024) draws on his unreleased 1994 to 1997 Korsakow tracks, plus Dub Taylor tracks.
profiles.Fred Everything: Fred Everything is a Montreal-based house DJ, producer and label owner who runs Lazy Days Recordings and hosted the Lazy Days Podcast (100 episodes, 2010 to 2021). He plays deep, soulful and vinyl-based house. His recordings come from Montreal (Sans Soleil, Salon Daomé, Stereo, Le Mellotron, MUTEK, CKUT), New York, Miami, San Francisco, London, Zagreb and other European cities. Radio and label ties include Defected Broadcasting House, Om Records, Cadenza, Sonar Kollektiv and KCRW. He often plays long sets and back-to-backs with Atjazz and Trevor Walker.
profiles.Pierre Marty: Pierre Marty is an electronic live-act performer and DJ. The recordings that belong to them are a 62-minute live rooftop set in Rome for the Enclave Rooftop Series (Episode III) and "Curiosity Freestyle 2", a 37-minute live act released on SoundCloud in 2020 through the Curious? channel. Their sets are live electronic performances for event series and online party channels.
profiles.Ida Daugaard: Ida Daugaard is a Danish DJ and former model who moved to Berlin and plays deep, minimal-leaning house and techno. She is a regular at Berlin clubs such as Club der Visionaere, Hoppetosse, Katerblau (Kater Blau), Ipse and Golden Gate, and at festivals such as Fusion, Garbicz and Marvellous Island. She also plays Hamburg (Südpol), Copenhagen (Culture Box, MS Artville) and Zurich (L.E.T). She has guest mixed for many podcasts and radio shows, including RTS.FM, Witness This, Kater_Club and Sound Mass.
profiles.O.Bee: O.BEE is a New York–based house and techno DJ and producer (Israeli-born, Tel Aviv roots) known for deep, groovy, club-leaning sets. He is a ReSolute NYC resident and runs the Jigit label and collective and the long-running "Can You Jigit?" radio show on The Lot Radio in Brooklyn, often with his b2b partner Tomas Station. He plays Circoloco at DC-10 Ibiza, fabric London, Boiler Room Istanbul, HÖR Berlin, Dimensions, Waking Life and Polifonic, and has put out mixes for Yoyaku, Rinse FM, Circoloco Radio and Lion's Milk.
profiles.Taylor Houseman: Taylor Houseman is a house and melodic/downtempo-leaning DJ rooted in the Southern California scene. Recordings cluster around San Diego's Afternoon Umbrella Friends crew (Umbrella Nights, Desert Hearts TV, Planet Umbrella, Condition) and Mindfruit SD (Bloom SD, Mindfruit stream), plus vinyl-only sets at Sunday Sessions LA at Apotheke in Los Angeles. He plays live vinyl and online-stream sets, with additional mixes for Hokum, Class-A Deviants and INDECENTE.
profiles.[a:rpia:r]: [a:rpia:r] (also written Arpiar) is a Romanian trio of Raresh, Petre Inspirescu (Pedro) and Rhadoo, three DJ/producers from the Bucharest scene behind the RPR Soundsystem and the a:rpia:r label and party brand. They play minimal, deep, hypnotic house and techno ("Rominimal"). They perform at clubs and festivals such as Circoloco at DC-10 Ibiza, Sunwaves in Mamaia, Fabric London, BPM Festival, Secret Solstice in Iceland and Casino Sinaia, and on tours in Latin America (Mexico City, Lima, Santiago) and Europe. Their long b2b sets with Ricardo Villalobos at DC-10 are well known.
profiles.Van Bellen: Joost van Bellen, who also plays as Van Bellen, is an Amsterdam DJ and producer who has been active since the late 1980s. He was a Roxy Amsterdam resident (1990 to 1997) and plays house, trance and techno. He has played Amsterdam parties and events such as Rauw, Sensation White, Valhalla Festival, Amsterdam Dance Event and Melkweg. He also plays at Tivoli in Utrecht and Paradiso in Amsterdam, and has appeared on Dutch broadcasters 3voor12 and 3FM. He also plays the Mary Go Wild nights and is part of the trio The Rad Pack.
profiles.Tornado Wallace: Tornado Wallace is an Australian house and disco DJ and producer who came up in Melbourne and later moved to Berlin. He plays warm, slow-burning, eclectic house, balearic and disco, often in long sets and back-to-backs. The recordings tie him to Melbourne, Sydney and Berlin, plus festival and club circuits in Europe and Asia (Love International, Sonder, Paradigm, Seoul, Hanoi, Tokyo). He has released on Running Back and is a regular on Boiler Room, HÖR, NTS, Dekmantel and The Lot Radio.
profiles.Phil Weeks: Phil Weeks (Philippe Benkemoun) is a Paris-based French house DJ and producer and the founder of Robsoul Recordings. He plays Chicago-rooted house, from deep to tech house, and produces with an Akai MPC3000 and Roland TR-909, including live PA sets. His home scene is Paris, especially Rex Club (Get Underground) and H2O Club. He also plays regularly in Amsterdam, Berlin, London, Bucharest, Ibiza, Spain, Italy and San Francisco, often alongside Mark Farina and DJ Sneak.
profiles.Raresh: Raresh is a Romanian minimal, microhouse and house DJ and producer from Bucharest. He is a core name of the Romanian minimal scene and a member of the trio [a:rpia:r] (Arpiar) with Rhadoo and Petre Inspirescu. He has a long partnership with Ricardo Villalobos (Sunrise parties, Cocoon, DC10 and Amnesia in Ibiza, Caprices, ADE). He plays Romanian clubs and festivals (Sunwaves, Sunrise, Nights.Ro, Midi Cluj, Heat Oradea) and international venues (Houghton, fabric London, Cocoon Ibiza, Secret Solstice, Dimensions, Unum Albania, Caprices Switzerland and Morocco, Lima, Tokyo, Brooklyn), and mixed fabric 78 (2014) and Cocoon Green & Blue (2011).
profiles.Ricardo Villalobos: Ricardo Villalobos is a Chilean-born, Berlin-based DJ and producer (born in Santiago, raised in Germany) known for minimal techno, microhouse and house. He rose through Berlin's Tresor, Cocoon (Frankfurt/Ibiza) and Robert Johnson scenes, and plays residencies and festivals such as Circoloco at DC-10, Pyramid at Amnesia Ibiza, Time Warp, Awakenings, Sunwaves and Sonne Mond Sterne. He is closely tied to the Romanian minimal scene (Raresh, Rhadoo, Petre Inspirescu, Sunrise events in Bucharest) and the Chilean circuit (Luciano, Santiago).
profiles.Sinéad: Sinéad is a house DJ raised in San Francisco and now based in New York, where she is a resident at Public Records in Brooklyn. She plays intuitive, groove-led house and has a long run of sets on The Lot Radio (Brooklyn), NTS, Refuge Worldwide and Rinse FM. Her Bay Area roots show in Fault Radio sets recorded in San Jose and Oakland and in the HydeFM shows she hosted with Siah Shekar. She has played alongside Tornado Wallace at Paradigm Festival 2025 and has a b2b with Scarlett O'Malley on Rinse FM.
